Other types: zero below F_DEFINE_MST[AK8Nn7ta=DUNGEON_NO_COST_LV].YjIUDJ97 (shipped 51) or SealUtil::isSealMission; otherwise apply active stamina-half event or DungeonBonusMst bonus type 1, rounding positive halves upward (GameUtils::getStaminaHalf 0x19f148c). shared_mission_cost_rule.server_action: Charge only at a fresh accepted start boundary, persist mission/session state and return updated point state. Resume/retry semantics require preserving the existing session; do not blindly charge another entry cost.

request.common_envelope: All requests also use existing BaseRequest user/auth LhVz6aD2, signal QCcFB3h9 and version c1qYg84Q. Reuse the server envelope. These inherited device/auth fields are not action arguments. BaseRequest::createBody 0x198f878, createUserInfoTag 0x198fa54, createSignalKeyTag 0x198f8ac, createVersionTag 0x198f930.
request.completeness: Action-specific serializers, inherited mission serializers and called nested result/carry/challenge/party/quest serializers are expanded. Generic inherited auth/device/version envelope is referenced separately to reuse the existing local server convention.

callers.detail: constructs MissionEndRequest then TowerEnd vtable

client_local_behavior: MissionEndScene::initConnect 0x234caf0 initializes result before request. Serializer reads accumulated battle result, achievements and challenges. Tower override does NOT send carry-item group, EndQuest tag or continue-count group.
server_state_changes: Finalize active floor once, apply client-managed switches according to F_SWITCH_MST/F_SWITCH_TYPE_MST, award validated result and challenge rewards, advance Tower progress. Persist full party/HP data needed for the next floor.

confirmed_tables.purpose: mission challenges and reward tuples, evaluated from 2urzfX6d battle logs; verify criteria rather than trusting client grant amounts

reward_sources.battle_rewards: Battle EXP/gil/drops are accumulated in MissionResultInfoBase and sent in 09HRWXDf. Server returns authoritative result 09HRWXDf and refreshes real inventory/currencies/roster. Reward drop/encounter definitions may be server-delivered battle tables; no complete reward definition table for these modes was found in mst_decoded. Do not treat master fV4Jn13q or dIPkNn61 as a reward tuple merely because of its shape.
reward_sources.implementation: Use PlayerState grant/spend conventions and groups(). Do not grant units merely because the request contains a party/HP snapshot. Preserve instance IDs separately from master IDs.

reply.dispatch: BaseRequest has no request-specific readParam; GameResponseFactory dispatches response tags globally. Exact action-to-tag inclusion is inferred from downstream data consumers unless noted.

shared_mission_cost_rule.calculation: Cost types 1 and 2 return raw amount. Other types: zero below F_DEFINE_MST[AK8Nn7ta=DUNGEON_NO_COST_LV].YjIUDJ97 (shipped 51) or SealUtil::isSealMission; otherwise apply active stamina-half event or DungeonBonusMst bonus type 1, rounding positive halves upward (GameUtils::getStaminaHalf 0x19f148c). Parade has an additional event-window free-cost branch at 0x1a78d14. MissionUtil::getUserPoint maps type 2 to UserTeamInfo+0x78 pointee+8, type 6 to +0x80 pointee+8, otherwise +0x3c. Names of the type-2/type-6 point accounts are not proved here. These are mission point costs, not item-kind currency codes.
shared_mission_cost_rule.server_action: Charge only at a fresh accepted start boundary, persist mission/session state and return updated point state. Resume/retry semantics require preserving the existing session; do not blindly charge another entry cost.
shared_mission_cost_rule.external_dependencies: EventSetMst and DungeonBonusMst are runtime response data in this corpus; do not fabricate absent calendar rows.

exact_magic_key_cost.when: fresh accepted Glory start with U92bySoZ true and eligible bonus gimmick; not restart or end

shared_mission_cost_rule.calculation: Cost types 1 and 2 return raw amount. Other types: zero below F_DEFINE_MST[AK8Nn7ta=DUNGEON_NO_COST_LV].YjIUDJ97 (shipped 51) or SealUtil::isSealMission; otherwise apply active stamina-half event or DungeonBonusMst bonus type 1, rounding positive halves upward (GameUtils::getStaminaHalf 0x19f148c). Parade has an additional event-window free-cost branch at 0x1a78d14. MissionUtil::getUserPoint maps type 2 to UserTeamInfo+0x78 pointee+8, type 6 to +0x80 pointee+8, otherwise +0x3c. shared_mission_cost_rule.server_action: Charge only at a fresh accepted start boundary, persist mission/session state and return updated point state. Resume/retry semantics require preserving the existing session; do not blindly charge another entry cost.

Reward drop/encounter definitions may be server-delivered battle tables; no complete reward definition table for these modes was found in mst_decoded. Do not treat master fV4Jn13q or dIPkNn61 as a reward tuple merely because of its shape.
reward_sources.implementation: Use PlayerState grant/spend conventions and groups(). Do not grant units merely because the request contains a party/HP snapshot. Preserve instance IDs separately from master IDs.

reply.dispatch: BaseRequest has no request-specific readParam; GameResponseFactory dispatches response tags globally. Exact action-to-tag inclusion is inferred from downstream data consumers unless noted.

minimal_reply.validation: static control-flow inference, not exercised against a running client
minimal_reply.preconditions: Use existing successful transport/encryption/header envelope and echo this request_id. $values below are substitution placeholders, not literal wire values. Loaded mission/battle/resource masters must exist before entering battle. An ACK alone may release a connection spinner while leaving mode data stale. Do not substitute empty arrays for destructive full-list state groups unless intentionally clearing them.
minimal_reply.status: INFERRED_TEMPLATE, not a runtime-validated minimal screen-unblock contract

reply.refresh_rules: Send authoritative changed groups. PlayerState.groups() does not include the mode-specific event/user/resume groups. Full-list responses must carry the full surviving list, not only a delta.

SurvivalMissionRetireRequest.confidence: high for request serialization; medium for endpoint reply requirements
unresolved: Whether retire drops all banked rewards or preserves an earlier checkpoint cannot be proved from this serializer alone. Do not claim a refund formula.
SurvivalMissionRetireRequest.evidence_scope: ELF virtual addresses in supplied arm64 libgame.so, static inspection; no project edits or runtime requests.
SurvivalMissionRetireRequest.server_state_change_basis: Field serialization, local state edits and named client readers are observed. Authoritative settlement, idempotency, refund and banking behavior are implementation obligations/inferences; the original server is not present in libgame.so. Unrecovered policy is explicitly listed, not claimed as retail behavior.

fields.meaning: selected area/subregion id -> F_AREA_MST.uv60hgDW; not a season-event id

request.common_envelope: All requests also use existing BaseRequest user/auth LhVz6aD2, signal QCcFB3h9 and version c1qYg84Q. Reuse the server envelope. These inherited device/auth fields are not action arguments. BaseRequest::createBody 0x198f878, createUserInfoTag 0x198fa54, createSignalKeyTag 0x198f8ac, createVersionTag 0x198f930.
request.completeness: Action-specific serializers, inherited mission serializers and called nested result/carry/challenge/party/quest serializers are expanded. Generic inherited auth/device/version envelope is referenced separately to reuse the existing local server convention.

callers.detail: constructor receives scene+0x5dc area id

client_local_behavior: After successful resource handling SurvivalReturnConnectScene::updateEvent 0x255f530 clears map work, SurvivalBattleUnitStateList::clearInfo at 0x255f640, resets BraveShift order at 0x255f644 and changes scene.
server_state_changes: Return/close the current Survival expedition for the requested area. Set authoritative resume/run status and reconcile any banked rewards once. No explicit reward list or currency spend in request.

confirmed_tables.purpose: mission challenges and reward tuples, evaluated from 2urzfX6d battle logs; verify criteria rather than trusting client grant amounts
event point milestone reward definitions; this does not prove these endpoints themselves claim every threshold
rank/summary reward definitions referenced by event SumallyId; claiming/distribution timing is not established by these requests

reward_sources.battle_rewards: Battle EXP/gil/drops are accumulated in MissionResultInfoBase and sent in 09HRWXDf. Server returns authoritative result 09HRWXDf and refreshes real inventory/currencies/roster. Reward drop/encounter definitions may be server-delivered battle tables; no complete reward definition table for these modes was found in mst_decoded. Do not treat master fV4Jn13q or dIPkNn61 as a reward tuple merely because of its shape.
reward_sources.implementation: Use PlayerState grant/spend conventions and groups(). Do not grant units merely because the request contains a party/HP snapshot. Preserve instance IDs separately from master IDs.

reply.dispatch: BaseRequest has no request-specific readParam; GameResponseFactory dispatches response tags globally. Exact action-to-tag inclusion is inferred from downstream data consumers unless noted.

callers.detail: uses shared operation info. RmReadyMissionScene writes current mission at 0x2457c64 first.

client_local_behavior: Serializer emits shared operation and party snapshots before envelope tags. After reply RmMissionStartScene::changeNextScene 0x24553c0 updates UserState and enters RmBattleScene.
server_state_changes: Start current mission inside active RM dungeon. Persist operation, random seed and party actual state; validate any mission point cost against boundary policy, not every resumed step.

shared_mission_cost_rule.calculation: Cost types 1 and 2 return raw amount. Other types: zero below F_DEFINE_MST[AK8Nn7ta=DUNGEON_NO_COST_LV].YjIUDJ97 (shipped 51) or SealUtil::isSealMission; otherwise apply active stamina-half event or DungeonBonusMst bonus type 1, rounding positive halves upward (GameUtils::getStaminaHalf 0x19f148c). Parade has an additional event-window free-cost branch at 0x1a78d14. MissionUtil::getUserPoint maps type 2 to UserTeamInfo+0x78 pointee+8, type 6 to +0x80 pointee+8, otherwise +0x3c. Names of the type-2/type-6 point accounts are not proved here. These are mission point costs, not item-kind currency codes.
shared_mission_cost_rule.server_action: Charge only at a fresh accepted start boundary, persist mission/session state and return updated point state. Resume/retry semantics require preserving the existing session; do not blindly charge another entry cost.
shared_mission_cost_rule.external_dependencies: EventSetMst and DungeonBonusMst are runtime response data in this corpus; do not fabricate absent calendar rows.

reply.dispatch: BaseRequest has no request-specific readParam; GameResponseFactory dispatches response tags globally. Exact action-to-tag inclusion is inferred from downstream data consumers unless noted.

request.completeness: Action-specific serializers, inherited mission serializers and called nested result/carry/challenge/party/quest serializers are expanded. Generic inherited auth/device/version envelope is referenced separately to reuse the existing local server convention.

callers.detail: constructs RmEndRequest

client_local_behavior: Copies remaining carry items, sends operation/party snapshots, result, achievements, challenges and conditional quest data.
After reply RmMissionEndScene::updateEvent 0x24550cc updates selected reinforcement, releases map data and moves to the RM mission result/next scene.
server_state_changes: Commit this mission/checkpoint once, save HP/MP/status, update RM progress and result channels and consumed items. Keep run state for next dungeon step; do not grant the same dungeon completion reward at both End and DungeonEnd.

confirmed_tables.purpose: mission challenges and reward tuples, evaluated from 2urzfX6d battle logs; verify criteria rather than trusting client grant amounts
event point milestone reward definitions; this does not prove these endpoints themselves claim every threshold

reward_sources.battle_rewards: Battle EXP/gil/drops are accumulated in MissionResultInfoBase and sent in 09HRWXDf. Server returns authoritative result 09HRWXDf and refreshes real inventory/currencies/roster. Reward drop/encounter definitions may be server-delivered battle tables; no complete reward definition table for these modes was found in mst_decoded. Do not treat master fV4Jn13q or dIPkNn61 as a reward tuple merely because of its shape.
reward_sources.implementation: Use PlayerState grant/spend conventions and groups(). Do not grant units merely because the request contains a party/HP snapshot. Preserve instance IDs separately from master IDs.

reply.dispatch: BaseRequest has no request-specific readParam; GameResponseFactory dispatches response tags globally. Exact action-to-tag inclusion is inferred from downstream data consumers unless noted.
